header: Tutorial: Detect high CPU usage with anomaly detection
content:
This tutorial demonstrates how to create an anomaly detector in Amazon OpenSearch Service to
detect high CPU usage. You'll use OpenSearch Dashboards to conﬁgure a detector to monitor CPU
usage, and generate an alert when your CPU usage rises above a speciﬁed threshold.
Note
These steps apply to the latest version of OpenSearch and might diﬀer slightly for past
versions.
